goal: Enable full-result OrderList sorting by SO Date, preserve the existing date rule and null-last stable ordering, and make Find positions use that same ordering. The 12-month window is out of scope.
assumptions: SO Date means the existing exact-primary ColdLion /orderHistory.createdTime rule, displayed in America/New_York.
Missing or conflicting timestamps sort as blank and remain last in both directions.
SO Date remains unavailable as a filter.
prohibited_actions: Do not change the 12-month OrderList window or its fallback date.
Do not change production schema or data directly.
Do not enable SO Date filtering.
stop_conditions: Stop if preview full-result ordering or query performance cannot be proven.
Stop if the change requires any database object outside the exact claim.
